Minors (R.I. Gen. Laws § 28-3-11): 16-17 may work during school vacations without weekly/daily limits (§ 28-3-11(c)), so no non-school-week rule for 16-17; under-18 need 8 hours off between workdays (not encoded). Under-16 RI limits are looser than federal 3 h/18 h (federal.json still applies).

rules.summary: Children under 16 in business or mercantile establishments may work at most 8 hours a day and 40 a week.

citation.title: R.I. Gen. Laws § 28-3-11 — Hours of work for children
citation.excerpt: No children under sixteen (16) years of age shall be employed ... more than forty (40) hours in any one week in any business or mercantile establishment ... exceed eight (8) hours in any one day.

rules.summary: Children under 16 in business or mercantile establishments may work at most 8 hours a day and 40 a week.

citation.title: R.I. Gen. Laws § 28-3-11 — Hours of work for children
citation.excerpt: No children under sixteen (16) years of age shall be employed ... more than forty (40) hours in any one week in any business or mercantile establishment ... exceed eight (8) hours in any one day.

rules.summary: Students 16-17 in business or mercantile establishments may work at most 9 hours a day and 48 a week, 6 a.m.-11:30 p.m. before a school day (1:30 a.m. otherwise).

citation.title: R.I. Gen. Laws § 28-3-11 — Hours of work for children
citation.excerpt: No child under eighteen (18) years of age shall be employed ... more than forty-eight (48) hours in any one workweek. In no case shall the hours of labor exceed nine (9) hours in any calendar day
